Bidder shall possess valid GST Registration, PAN and FSSAI Licence and all certificatementioned i n SoW. 2. Bidder shall have minimum five (05) years' experience in providing catering servicesor event ma nagement services involving catering arrangements. 3. Bidder shall have successfully executed minimum five (05) similar assignments involving caterin g services during the last five (05) years for Government Departments, Government Organizations, Univer sities, Autonomous Bodies or Public Sector Undertakings (PSUs). The bidder shall submit copies of work or ders and satisfactory completion certificates/client certificates as documentary evidence. 4. Bidder shall submit a self-declaration regarding non-blacklisting by any GovernmentDepartment, Government Organization, PSU, University, Autonomous Body or Statutory Authority. 5. Catering services shall be provided strictly as per the menu specifications and requirements men tioned in the Financial BOQ forming part of this bid. 6. The contract shall remain valid for a period of two (02) year from the date of award of contract a nd may be extended for a further period of one (01) year on satisfactory performance and mutual consent. 7. The successful bidder shall provide catering services at the existing campus of the University or any other campus or at a venue designated by KSU, including the permanent campus, as may be decided by the University during the contract period. 8. The University reserves the right to inspect and verify the kitchen, infrastructure and other facilit ies of the successful bidder before commencement of the contract and at any time during the contract peri od. 9. Financial evaluation and determination of the L1 bidder shall be carried out on the basis of the total eval uated price as per the Financial BOQ forming part of this bid.

10. The University reserves the right to place orders for any item(s) from the approved menu depe nding upon actual requirements. 11. Orders shall be placed strictly on requirement basis. The University does not guarantee any min imum quantity, minimum business or minimum value of work during the contract period. 12. The successful bidder shall ensure that sufficient trained manpower, serving arrangements, tra nsportation and other necessary resources are deployed to provide timely and satisfactory catering services as per the requirements of the University. 13. The Grand Total of all Plans (sum of Plan A through Plan G across all menu options), as comput ed in the Price Bid sheet, shall be the basis for determining the Lowest Bidder (L1) for the purpose of awar d of this tender. Bidders must quote against every line item; any item left blank may render the bid liable f or rejection.Bidders should quote this amount in their final price bid, and L1 will be decided based on this price only. (Applicable to Plan A to Plan G.) 14. The University’s temporary address is Block No. 3, Vishwakarma Government Engineering College Ca mpus, Chandkheda, Ahmedabad – 382424, Gujarat, and its permanent address is near Western Time s Publication, Palodiya Tekra, Shilaj, Ahmedabad, Gujarat. The University shall shift to its permanent campus shortly after completion of construction, and the catering service provider shall deploy personnel a nd resources accordingly, as directed by the University. .
